title: Summarize all matching salesman order evidence by original currency
description: Users see an all-matching original-currency summary alongside current-page salesman/currency details. Add narrow summary DTOs and pure rules, derive the summary from the same complete bounded authorized filtered SalesmanOutputItem list before selected-column projection or paging; no second source query and no client/page-row aggregation. One bucket per persisted raw Currency key; known currencies sum signed decimal TotalAmount without rounding each salesman first, assigned approved-order count sums disjoint OrderCount, salesman count is distinct SalesmanId within bucket. Unknown/invalid raw currency keys remain distinct with amount=null and explicit unknown-order count, never assumed CNY or zero. Profit and profit rate remain null for all buckets with historical-cost-basis explanation; no current-price cost/profit calculation. Stable raw-key ordering, no cross-currency grand total/comparison. Always show date/current customer/salesman/currency filters/source caps and all-matching coverage, independent of selected fields or current page. Empty matching dataset differs from empty/out-of-range detail page; summary remains populated on an empty page when source matches. Preserve detail page-only Excel/PDF and existing report/home behavior. Development only: reuse the existing salesman-output menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted assigned-salesman SalesOrders and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Every endpoint validates current requests and rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope, rejecting invalid/revoked/500-order-cap overflow without data/file. Employee filters never broaden ERP permissions. Evidence remains assigned approved sales orders, not all ERP orders, production, actual revenue/shipment/receipts. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Pure summary rules aggregate the complete bounded scoped filtered source before paging, with per-original-currency signed known amount and distinct salesman/disjoint order counts, preserving raw unknown buckets.
Unknown currency amounts and all profit/rate metrics remain explicit null with basis/count evidence; no incompatible currency sum, current-price profit inference or selected-page-only summary.

Preview/designer render a separate all-matching summary with date/filter/cap/coverage context on hidden fields and empty detail pages; summary/API/UI/detail-export regressions and safe Release build/test pass.
